acceptance.count: Exactly two shared trainer invocations; one per requested sample.
acceptance.failure: Retain partial policies, phase events, original traceback and source snapshots; stop later samples on first error, no retry or discarded run.
acceptance.interpretation: Single-call phase/allocation observations only, not throughput, medians, speedup, RSS, stable memory advantage, convergence rate or general bottleneck claims.
acceptance.policy: Both complete raw reports must match the authenticated baseline pilot bytes and artifact checksum exactly.
acceptance.sources: Clean committed identical revision/status/LF identities before/after every call and overall.

measurement_scope.allocation: Separate call without phase wrappers; tracemalloc peak includes new Python allocations in library call/serialization/hash, excludes RSS/native/preexisting allocations and is not a total memory bound.
measurement_scope.counter: A reversible shared-trainer wrapper counts invocations and delegates unchanged recurrence. Counter overhead is included in both calls.
measurement_scope.excluded: Prerequisite baseline-byte authentication, outer source snapshots, gzip compression/file I/O and subsequent saved replay.
measurement_scope.included: One complete baseline library call plus canonical JSON serialization and SHA256. Internal proof authentication, physical preparation, training, normalization, lift and audit are included.
measurement_scope.phase: Inclusive nested wall/CPU times overlap, include reversible instrumentation and must not be summed across ancestors/descendants.
measurement_scope.process: Two sequential calls in one persistent process; GC before each, imports/preflight already warm. No fresh-process or cold-start claim.

preflight.scope_note: Named loop charges and separate physical census references; not all arithmetic, elapsed time, CPU, allocated bytes or RSS.

runtime_admission.meaning: Reject a different runtime before any measured solver call because full raw pilot bytes include this runtime identity.
